newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kader says to place 100 mln warrants.
newsitem.headline: Kader says to place 100 mln warrants.

text.p: Toy maker Kader Holdings Co Ltd said it had agreed to privately place 100 million 1997-1998 warrants to independent investors at HK$0.25 per warrant.
Each warrant entitles holders the right to buy one Kader share at a subscription price of HK$1.00 per share, subject to adjustment, for any period up to June 30, 1998, it said.
A total 100 million new shares, or 15.89 percent of the the company's enlarged share capital, will be required to be issued on full conversion of the warrants, it said.
Application will be made to list the warrant in Hong Kong, and dealing in the warrants is expected to begin on April 7.
Kader said net proceeds of HK$22.5 million from the warrant issue would be used for general working capital.
The company shares rose HK$0.07 to HK$1.19 at midday.
